title: Listing reports
description: Review reports submitted by users for inappropriate listings.

help.title: About listing reports
help.overview: Reports users send about a listing: inappropriate, spam, misleading or other, with a comment. An administrator reviews and decides them.

sections.title: Each report
items: One report per user and listing. While it's pending, the reporter can change the reason and comment.
Reports are private: administrators see all of them, everyone else only their own.
Resolve report upholds it: choose whether to deactivate the listing at the same time or keep it live.
Dismiss report rejects it. Either decision needs a note.
